Here is the weekly ASX X (Twitter) thread for the week of 12 October 2026:

Post 1

📈 ASX 200 closed at 8,847 pts last week. The real question: can materials hold the rally as USD strength bites? Mixed view — domestic resilience is real, but offshore headwinds are building. Watch 8,900 as the line in the sand. #ASX #ausbiz #markets

Post 2

⛏️ Mining faces a pivotal week as iron ore hovers near key support — any China demand signal moves the sector fast. Banks also in focus ahead of lending data; credit growth trajectory will set the tone for the majors. #ASX #mining #ironore #banking

Post 3

🔺 One stock commanding attention: BHP. Trading near a technically significant level, with iron ore price direction and Chinese stimulus follow-through as the binary catalyst. Position sizing matters here. #ASX #BHP #mining #ironore

Post 4

S&P 500 closed Friday near 5,780 pts, with US CPI still running above the Fed's comfort zone. A hawkish Fed repricing would pressure AUD and hit yield-sensitive ASX sectors hard. Global risk appetite sets Monday's open. #ASX #ausbiz #Fed #inflation

Post 5

Thursday's Australian employment report is the week's sharpest risk. Market pricing holds RBA steady, but a miss below 20,000 jobs added reopens rate cut talk and lifts rate-sensitive sectors. A beat pressures bonds. Which way are you positioned? #ASX #RBA #ausbiz #economy

Post 1
📈 ASX 200 snapped back hard on Monday — up 66.60pts or 0.76% to 8,783.20. Financials and Materials led the charge while Telcos sank. Five-day run now +1.11%, yet the index is flat year to date. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🏦 Financials +1.56% and Materials +1.52% carried the session. Telcos dragged hardest, down 1.94%, with A-REITs close behind at -1.39%. Two clear winners, two clear drags. #ASX #banking #materials #ausbiz

Post 3
🔺 ZIP CO surged 5.56% to AUD 2.28, one of Monday's sharpest moves in the index. Buy-now-pay-later catching a bid while the broader consumer discretionary sector slipped -0.42%. #ASX #fintech #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold holding at AUD 6,027.15/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6984. Silver at AUD 87.46/oz. A softer Aussie dollar amplifies commodity prices in local terms — tailwind for Materials names. #gold #silver #commodities #ASX

Post 5
Flat year to date at 8,783.20 with a five-day tailwind of +1.11% — the index needs a catalyst to break higher. Can Financials sustain their lead this week, or do Telcos drag the tape? Drop your call below. #ASX #ausbiz
